context: This repository is a Pi plugin monorepo built with npm workspaces. Shared plumbing lives in packages/core/src/, the guard plugins in packages/content-guard/src/ and packages/placement-guard/src/, their tests in packages/<name>/test/, and documentation in the repository root.

rules.name: Placement
checks: Is the new file placed in the directory that best matches its purpose in the existing project structure?
Is the new file grouped with related files rather than placed in an unrelated directory?
Is the new file's name consistent with the naming conventions of the existing files?

checks.check: Does the new file duplicate or overlap with an existing file?
Does the new file introduce a new directory without a clear reason?

rules.fail:
Post write placement check failed for {file}:
{checks}
No file created.
Choose a directory or file name that fits the existing tree, then retry the write.
